prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1273; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. Presenting complaints included neck pain with restricted cervical range of motion, mid and low back pain, and muscle tightness with intermittent headaches. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness at the cervical and lumbar levels, reduced rotation to the left, and no neurological deficits in the upper or lower extremities. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red flag findings.

Management consisted of a combination of manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, heat and soft tissue treatment, and a progressive home exercise program. Over a course of 29 visits the patient demonstrated steady improvement in range of motion, decreased pain intensity, and improved tolerance for sitting and driving. Headache frequency decreased substantially by the middle of the treatment course.

At discharge the patient reported residual stiffness with prolonged positioning but was functioning independently in daily activities and work duties. The patient was instructed to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen. Prognosis for full recovery is good.
